note: C-12 had NO case at all, which meant bsi.precision.f32 could never be declared: MC68-03 only lets an engine declare a capability whose family is green, and a family with no case is never green. This case exists so that the capability becomes declarable; until an implementation declares f32 it SKIPs, and a SKIP is printed, not counted green (BSI_ADD1 section 7 B3). Same world twice, storage f64 and f32. The structural half -- section present, named stations:f32, bytes == 44 * count -- is checked by the runner's C-1 pass for every reply. What is asserted here is that the halved section carries the SAME numbers to the contract's own display-track tolerance (Part F, C-12: rel <= 1e-5). The stricter line, f32 == (float)f64 bitwise, belongs to the engine's own gate (MC65b-06), not to a cross-engine corpus.

assert.note: the reply must say which storage it actually used; an engine that quietly answers in f64 is claiming a bandwidth saving it did not make
storage narrows the display sections only: equilibrium stays f64 (BSI B.5)
